title: 亮度开窗 / Luma windows
author: Rhythm Master
license_status: First-party composition using existing attributed operators; outbound license pending

descriptions.en-US: Cut transparent windows along source luminance bands while keeping the original image colors. Bass/high bands sweep the slices; set density, width, feather and inversion.
descriptions.zh-CN: 沿输入图像亮度带开出透明窗口，并保留原图颜色。低频和高频移动切片，可调密度、宽度、柔边与反转。
